full_explanation.summary: An email gateway detected a phishing attempt targeting billing@invoice.example with a malicious URL, requiring immediate verification of the actual recipient.
full_explanation.why_it_matters: This is a HIGH severity threat that could compromise credentials if the malicious URL was used to steal data from the actual user account.
verify_first: Review the email headers to confirm the actual recipient is not the sender.
Check proxy URL clicks and identity sign-ins to verify the user submitted credentials to the malicious domain.
next_steps: Investigate the actual recipient and verify no new suspicious sign-ins occurred.
If malicious delivery is confirmed, quarantine matching messages and reset affected accounts.
Verify no new suspicious sign-ins occurred after remediation.
